levels.surface: أبو يعقوب يوسف بن محمد بن زياد
أبو الحسن علي بن محمد بن سيار

notes: «عن أبويهما» names their fathers only by relation (kind relation); no name is added.
The Imam Hasan inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his tafsir.
The man who asked al-Sadiq in the saying is only in the scene (rule 6): not a link.
